wish: someone should make a board game combining Monopoly and Risk with world takeover and economy
spec:
Hot-seat board game for 2 to 4 players on an 11-territory world map: buy territories for income, pay coins to add armies, attack neighbours with Risk-style dice.
Tap a territory, then use Buy, Add army or Attack; End turn collects the next player's income. Last player holding territories wins.
It does not have AI players, cards, or online play; one device is passed around.
